title: A Joomla slot that is one text node of an HTML value takes the writer's paragraphs as one, so the contract stays readable
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: On the JA Diner Joomla 1.0.8 kit, article-28.4 written as three paragraphs exports as one paragraph with no ((p)) codes; a whole-element slot keeps its paragraphs and a bullets slot its list.

tests: a text node slot takes every paragraph of the writer as one, even where the kit counts three
a slot that is a whole element, or no HTML at all, keeps its paragraphs and lists
